options: exact answers through the shim of geotruth.harness.engine: geotruth.relate / geotruth.overlay when they exist, else the witness relate and the fallback overlay of tests/reference/indep.py (GEOTRUTH_EXACT_BACKEND selects)

overlay output: the non-strict exact result, every coordinate correctly rounded to a double; where rounding breaks validity the rounded rings are regularized exactly and rounded again (geotruth.harness.regularize.round_valid)
relate, predicates and overlay are 'unsupported' for invalid input and null where the engine abstains
